business_summary: Tone Co., Ltd. develops, manufactures, and sells work tools, torque management equipment, and bolt fastening equipment under the TONE brand name in Japan, East Asia, North and Central America, Europe, and internationally. The company offers tool sets, storage, automotive and cycle tools, torque wrenches, titanium tools, air tools, repair/accessory parts, and other tools. It also provides labor-saving effort tools comprising electric tools, construction No.1, nutrunner, shear wrench, torshat, power digi torque/power wrench, and equipment socket. In addition, the company offers work tools consisting of socket wrench set, socket/adapter, hammer/blow tool, handle, T and L wrench, drivers, bits, adjustable wrench/pipe wrench, spanner/box wrench, and pliers. It serves general, aerospace, construction, automotive, bridge, plant, transportation, communication, and alternative energy industries. The company was formerly known as Maeda Metal Industries, Ltd. and changed its name to Tone Co., Ltd. in November 2013. Tone Co., Ltd. was founded in 1938 and is headquartered in Arakawa, Japan.
